steps.title: Branch, plan, pinned dependencies and decision records
steps.summary: Branch phase-03-vault from main (Phases 0-2 merged as 51e4f9d). Six crates pinned: rusqlite 0.41.1 (bundled, native only so wasm still builds), quick-xml 0.42.0, totp-rs 6.0.0, p256 0.14.0, ml-kem 0.3.4, serde_json 1.0.154. Decisions D-0301..D-0306 recorded; plan written; .work/ ignored for helper scripts.

steps.title: Vault item model: 8 kinds, 7 India templates, strict fields and history
steps.summary: Vault item model: 13 kinds (6 generic + 7 India templates) with a closed field set per template, strict field/URL/tag/custom validation, last-10 secret history, and canonical-CBOR payloads capped at 1 MiB. Look-alike field names are rejected on build and on parse (R-0114). 23 new tests.

steps.title: Op log: hash, signatures, DAG materialisation, heads, rollback and fork detection
steps.summary: Op log: canonical CBOR ops, BLAKE3 op hash, Ed25519 over the hash, strict parsing with exact key sets, DeviceRegistry with revocation cut-offs, DAG with parent/Lamport/duplicate-id rules, signed VaultHead, verify_descends and check_head_update (rollback vs fork), and materialisation with the (lamport, device_id) conflict rule. 30 new tests, including all six tamper vectors.

steps.title: Account API: create, unlock, lock, device certification, vault keyring
steps.summary: Account API: create_account derives the MUK, wraps the AK and seals a six-entry key bundle (identities incl. ML-KEM-768, device list, head pins, version); unlock opens every entry under its own AAD; UnlockedAccount certifies and revokes devices, wraps/unwraps vault keys, pins heads, re-seals the bundle and wipes on lock. Device certificates gained strict storage CBOR. 14 new tests plus one ignored real-Argon2 test.

steps.title: Storage: LocalStore trait, in-memory store and SQLite store
steps.summary: Local storage: a LocalStore trait over ciphertext only, an in-memory implementation and a SQLite implementation (native only, STRICT tables, secure_delete, schema version checked on open). No plaintext columns exist; a test opens the database file and proves the demo title, password and URL do not appear in it.

steps.title: Encrypted .studgevault backup and the exporters
steps.summary: Encrypted .studgevault backup: a container of already-encrypted records (account bundle, wrapped vault keys, heads, ops) with a magic header and strict parsing, needing no new key or label (D-0307). Plus the three plaintext exporters (JSON, CSV, KeePass XML) that each refuse without allow_plaintext and carry a PLAINTEXT warning. 16 new tests.

steps.title: Generator: passwords, EFF passphrases, entropy estimate
steps.summary: Generator: passwords (length, charsets, exclude-ambiguous) and EFF passphrases (7776-word list bundled with CC-BY attribution, separator, capitalisation, digit) with lower-bound entropy estimates. Selections use rejection sampling over OsRng so no value is favoured by modulo bias; results are zeroizing. 11 tests.

steps.title: TOTP: RFC 6238 vectors and otpauth:// parsing
steps.summary: TOTP: TotpConfig over totp-rs with strict otpauth:// parsing (duplicate or unknown parameters rejected, label and issuer must agree), base32 and percent codecs with canonical-form checks, and the full RFC 6238 vector set. Secrets under 128 bits are accepted through the non-compliant path and flagged via is_legacy_strength so the UI can warn (D-0309). 12 new tests.

steps.title: Importers A: Bitwarden, Chrome, Apple, Dashlane, generic CSV
steps.summary: Importers A: Bitwarden JSON and CSV, Chrome, Apple Passwords, Dashlane and a generic CSV mapper, all over a hand-written strict RFC 4180 reader (256 columns, 1 MiB/field, 200k rows). Every importer returns ImportReport{imported, skipped} where skips are an enum plus a row index, never file content; unknown template fields are errors, not silent drops. Fake fixtures in core/tests/fixtures/import.

steps.title: Importers B: 1Password export.data, Proton Pass, KeePass XML
steps.summary: Importers B: 1Password export.data, Proton Pass and KeePass 2.x XML. KeePass uses quick-xml with a strict element set, DTD/entity/PI rejection, a depth cap of 64 and a 1 MiB value cap; History subtrees are skipped. 1PUX takes the extracted member (no ZIP crate) and rejects raw ZIP bytes with a clear error. 14 new tests.

steps.title: vault_tour demo and the preview op-log graph
Docs, self-attack review, issues and pull request

try_it.label: Vault tour (DEMO ONLY, fake data)
try_it.expect: Fake vault with Aadhaar, PAN and UPI items; the op log as a table; a conflict resolved by the SPEC rule; a Bitwarden import report.

risks.title: R-0001 — CodeQL code scanning skipped while the repository is private (issue #23)
R-0103 — A cloned VM or broken RNG could repeat a nonce; mitigated by OsRng-only random and no software fallback
R-0108 — A weak master password plus a stolen Secret Key allows offline guessing; Argon2id 64 MiB/t=3/p=1 is the mitigation
R-0116 — Vault-key wrapping is X25519-only; hpke 0.15 now ships X-Wing, so Phase 11 can switch
R-0117 — test-vectors feature exposes fixed-nonce sealing; documented test-only, never in release builds
R-0118 — The Secret Key check character is 5 bits: a typo inside the alphabet has a 1-in-32 chance of passing and then fails safely at the MUK
R-0119 — HPKE base mode gives no sender authentication; correct for vault-key wrapping, must not be presented as authentication
